{{Top}}
An '''assault rifle''' was a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]].<ref name="RPG-2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> Both [[Theron Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] used a heavy variant on his mission to steal a [[black cipher]] from the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="TOR-A">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>
